title: Phantom Blade Zero Platforms - PS5 and PC Now, Xbox Not Announced
description: Phantom Blade Zero is out on PS5 and PC via Steam and Epic. Xbox and Switch 2 have never been announced, the PS5 disc version is 2027, and this page tracks the status of every platform.

sections.title: Is Phantom Blade Zero Coming to Xbox?
sections.content:
No Xbox version has been announced. Not a date, not a window, not a stated intention. That has been true since the game was revealed at the PlayStation Showcase in 2023, and launching on two platforms has not changed it.

Two things are worth keeping separate. First, "not announced" is not "exclusive forever": S-GAME has never described the game as a permanent PlayStation exclusive, and the PC version ships on Epic as well as Steam, which shows the studio is not tying itself to one storefront. Second, there is no timed-exclusivity window in any public document, so anyone quoting "Xbox in six months" or "Xbox in a year" is inventing it.

If an Xbox version is announced it will be posted here and on the news page the same day. Until then, treat any date you see elsewhere as unsourced.

sections.title: Switch 2
sections.content: Nothing announced. The game is an Unreal Engine 5 title that does not hold 30 frames per second on Steam Deck in a post-patch retest, so a Switch 2 port would be a substantial technical project rather than a straight conversion. There is no evidence one is in progress.

sections.title: Steam or Epic?
sections.content:
Both sell the same game at the same price. Steam is the version with the larger public player count, workshop-adjacent modding, and the store page that carries the Denuvo label. Epic is the alternative storefront with the same build.

Practically: if you care about mods, controller remapping tools or refunds through playtime, Steam is the safer default. Nothing about the game's content differs between them.

sections.title: Platform Performance Notes
sections.content:
PS5. The console version is the one S-GAME tuned first; the launch patch notes mark several fixes as PC-only, which implies the console build did not need them. PS5 Pro Enhanced is listed on the store page.

PC. The 4 November patch changed shader compilation, so start-up is faster but the first launch after updating can pause for a recompile if you play with ray tracing off. Bluetooth controller stutter was reduced in the same build, and NVIDIA Reflex now works on Auto with V-Sync on. The PC requirements page covers hardware and the Deck situation.

sections.title: Platform Questions
sections.content:
Is Phantom Blade Zero coming to PC?

It is already on PC. Steam and Epic Games Store both sell it at the same price as the PS5 version.

Is Phantom Blade Zero a PlayStation exclusive?

It launched on PS5 and PC on the same day, so no. It is a console launch exclusive at most, and S-GAME has never described the arrangement as permanent.

Will Phantom Blade Zero be on Xbox?

Not announced. There is no date, no window and no stated plan.

Does it run on Steam Deck?

It is playable but does not hold 30 frames per second in a post-patch retest, so it is not a comfortable Deck game.
